operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run verify && pnpm check:deployment-spec && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: stop writes, retain the exact source revision and private configuration, export this installation with rer export, restore into a fresh empty installation with rer import, and compare a new export before routing traffic. Preserve applied migration names and bytes; inactive grants and changed-owner recovery remain unqualified.
